rows.grounds: genitive plural of compound kaulika-vastu, indicating the materials belonging to kaula practice
nominative plural subject denoting formed lumps or balls
indeclinable conjunction adding to the preceding ritual description
compound rudhira-ukṣita describing the masses as sprinkled with blood

items.question: How are the masses of kaulika substances ritually prepared in this context?
premises: Kaulika substances are formed into masses.
These masses undergo a specific ritual treatment.
The treatment involves sprinkling with blood.
items.inference: The masses of kaulika substances are ritually prepared by being sprinkled with blood.
uncertainties: The exact nature and composition of the kaulika substances are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the masses of kaulika substances are sprinkled with blood.
